traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Love and value meet imagination. Heightened artistic sensibility and romantic idealism. Fused, these drives are difficult to separate and ask to be consciously integrated rather than acted out blindly.

readerCopy.body: Something can feel beautiful, meaningful, and completely right while you are still filling in half the story yourself. When Venus conjuncts Neptune, attraction, hope, creativity, and idealization can blur together, making a person, offer, purchase, or relationship feel more complete than the facts currently make it. You do not need to ruin the feeling by interrogating it, but you do need to notice what you actually know and what you have lovingly supplied on its behalf. Let the beauty be real without requiring the fantasy to become a contract.
